title: Model A/B: eleven_v4_turbo against eleven_v4 on 11 representative lines, each by nitzi and hero-son. Same text, same settings; only the model differs. Listen to each pair side by side.
note: Ids sort in pairs: 01-hero-turbo, 01-hero-v4, 01-nitzi-turbo, 01-nitzi-v4. Settings are the usual ones (stability 0.5, similarity 0.75); the celebration uses the cheer style (0.1 / 0.8). Texts are the voice text as the tool sends it (kept points included). No parent-facing line is voiced in the app, so none is here.
